rows.status: Differences decrease on these three levels; this alone does not establish convergence.

comparison.comparison: Adjacent-grid differences are formed first, using the same refinement ratio. The finer difference is then interpolated onto the coarsest cell-center grid. Interpolation contributes to the measured order.
comparison.limitation: Observed order is a finite-resolution diagnostic, not a rigorous error estimate. Check more levels, temporal/spatial contamination and domain sensitivity separately. No theorem, stability certification or physical validation is inferred.

balance.interpretation: Recomputed from saved arrays and model data; imported diagnostics are ignored. Boundary rate is diffusive input (positive into the domain). Bulk includes reactions, sources and non-diffusive transport as written. Trapezoidal integration uses saved times, so the balance defect includes temporal discretization and output-sampling error. An operator-closure residual is an algebraic consistency check, not continuum accuracy or physical validation.
